data.name: PluginDescription
data.value: Extracts technical media information for audio and video STRM items and routes video playback through the current Emby server.

data.name: EditorTitle
data.value: STRM Bridge

data.name: EditorDescription
data.value: Extracts technical media information for selected audio and video STRM items. The in-process playback gateway applies only to video STRM items.

data.name: Enabled
data.value: Enable plugin

data.name: PlaybackMode
data.value: Playback routing mode

data.name: PlaybackModeDescription
data.value: Applies only to video STRM items in included libraries. Adaptive (recommended): players read ordinary direct-play files from a validated source address; server-side transcode or remux jobs use a job-local loopback address and hand off to the final source as early as possible; the plugin rewrites HLS manifests and Emby relays resources that cannot be handed off safely; remote TS/M2TS server processing supports evidence-based fast positioning. RedirectOnly: the requester reads directly from a validated final source without HLS manifest relay rewriting. RelayOnly: Emby relays all media data. Native: uses Emby's original playback flow.

data.name: EnableFastSeek
data.value: Enable evidence-based fast positioning

data.name: EnableFastSeekDescription
data.value: Enabled by default. Disabling it keeps normal gateway routing, redirects, relay, and HLS behavior, and disables only evidence-based positioning for remote TS/M2TS server processing. Use this capability switch to isolate seek behavior; routing never depends on client names.

data.name: ExtractAfterLibraryScan
data.value: Extract after library scan

data.name: OnlyMissingMediaInfo
data.value: Only extract missing media information

data.name: OnlyMissingMediaInfoDescription
data.value: When enabled, audio sources with an internal audio stream and video sources with an internal video stream are skipped when duration and container are also valid. Disable it or explicitly force extraction to probe again.

data.name: EnablePersistence
data.value: Save recovery snapshots

data.name: EnablePersistenceDescription
data.value: Controls only the plugin's recovery snapshots. Disabling it stops new recovery snapshots from being saved; successfully extracted technical fields are still written to Emby.

data.name: MaximumExtractionConcurrency
data.value: Maximum extraction concurrency

data.name: ExtractionTimeoutSeconds
data.value: Per-item timeout in seconds

data.name: GatewayTimeoutSeconds
data.value: Gateway upstream timeout in seconds

data.name: DirectRedirectCacheSeconds
data.value: Direct redirect cache duration (seconds)

data.name: DirectRedirectCacheSecondsDescription
data.value: Defaults to 20 seconds. Set to 0 to resolve a fresh Location from the source for every request. A value from 1 to 60 reuses a validated redirect target only within the playback ticket, without the plugin requesting its media, and advertises the same private cache lifetime to the client. Set to 0 for single-use signed URLs.

data.name: RedirectHopLimit
data.value: Maximum redirect hops

data.name: RelayConcurrency
data.value: Maximum relay concurrency

data.name: IncludedLibraryIds
data.value: Included media libraries

data.name: IncludedLibraryIdsDescription
data.value: Select one or more Emby libraries containing STRM items. Extraction supports audio and video; playback routing applies only to video. Leave empty to disable all STRM Bridge processing.

data.name: DetectedRedirectHosts
data.value: Detected redirect hosts

data.name: DetectedRedirectHostsDescription
data.value: Select only pending hosts you trust and save. Detections are persisted as normalized hostnames or IP addresses, remain visible after restart, and show current trust status; schemes, ports, paths, queries, fragments, and credentials are not retained. Saving new trust automatically retries waiting media. You can also enter an exact host, IP range, or explicit subdomain rule such as *.example.com below.

data.name: TrustedHostSuffix
data.value: (trusted)

data.name: AllowedRedirectHosts
data.value: Trusted upstream hosts

data.name: AllowedRedirectHostsDescription
data.value: Enter an exact host, IP address, CIDR, or *.example.com subdomain rule. Same-host hops are trusted; cross-host redirects are checked before connection. Direct connections to names resolving to private or special-use addresses also require IP/CIDR approval. System-proxied destinations are resolved by the proxy. Rejected addresses appear in the detection list; literal IP sources remain supported.

data.name: AwaitingApprovalNotificationTitle
data.value: STRM Bridge is waiting for approval

data.name: AwaitingApprovalNotificationDescription
data.value: Detected {0} unapproved redirect host(s). Some media are waiting for approval. Open STRM Bridge settings to review them.

data.name: RetryCompletedNotificationTitle
data.value: STRM Bridge automatic retry completed

data.name: RetryCompletedNotificationDescription
data.value: Extracted {0}, restored {1}, skipped {2}, failed {3}.

data.name: ConcurrencyValidation
data.value: Concurrency must be 1 or 2.

data.name: TimeoutValidation
data.value: Extraction and gateway timeouts must stay within their displayed ranges.

data.name: GatewayValidation
data.value: Redirect hops and relay concurrency must stay within their displayed ranges.

data.name: DirectRedirectCacheValidation
data.value: Direct redirect cache duration must be between 0 and 60 seconds.

data.name: LibraryValidation
data.value: Every media library ID must be a GUID.

data.name: RedirectHostValidation
data.value: Each entry must be an exact DNS name, IP address, CIDR range, or one explicit subdomain rule such as *.example.com. Schemes, paths, ports, and other wildcard forms are not allowed.

data.name: RedirectHostCapacityValidation
data.value: No more than 256 redirect-host rules may be configured.

data.name: ScheduledTaskName
data.value: Extract missing STRM media information

data.name: ScheduledTaskDescription
data.value: Safely probes missing technical media information for supported local audio and video STRM files.

data.name: ClearStoredMediaInfoTaskName
data.value: Clear stored STRM Bridge media information

data.name: ClearStoredMediaInfoTaskDescription
data.value: Manually clears STRM Bridge snapshots and extraction state, plus internal technical media information for STRM items in selected libraries. External streams and media files are retained.

data.name: ScheduledTaskCategory
data.value: Library

data.value: STRM Bridge has not finished initializing.

data.value: The item ID must be a GUID.

data.name: InvalidLibraryIdError

data.name: AuthenticatedUserRequiredError
data.value: An authenticated Emby user is required.

data.name: AdministratorRequiredError
data.value: An Emby administrator is required.

data.name: EnableSubtitles
data.value: Embedded text subtitles (optional)

data.name: EnableSubtitlesDescription
data.value: Stream embedded MKV text subtitles in supported Emby Web players. Subtitle reads use server bandwidth in non-Native modes.
